note:
ASPEN practice tool: malnutrition risk screening in adult oncology outpatients. This is the document that names the screening instruments themselves -- MST, MUST, MNA, NRS-2002, NUTRISCORE and PG-SGA SF -- and says which are validated for ambulatory cancer patients.

What it does **not** carry is the score-to-category cut-point. The clinical recommendation says the six tools were validated 'with various cut-points' and the characteristics table is tool-and-description, with no thresholds. So this document tells the panel which instrument is admissible and why; it does not tell it what an MNA of 7 means. That reading lives in `rcpia/rules/support.py` as `MNA_MALNOURISHED`, which is where instrument scoring belongs -- a threshold is arithmetic, not a retrievable statement.

default.note: Screening applies on entry to an oncology pathway, before the tumour setting is known. That is the point of screening.
